title: AI + Web3 — Ring Platform
description: How Ring combines AI opportunity matching with credit-balance rewards, a sponsored Solana native token, Token Desk, MicroDAO native-token votes, gasless sends, NFT gates, and a secondary NFT marketplace.

hero.title: AI that matches people — Web3 that moves value
hero.subtitle: Ring Platform pairs AI opportunity matching with a real money stack: earn credit-balance rewards for contribution, convert to your clone’s sponsored Solana SPL token without holding SOL, send to contacts, vote with native-token MicroDAO payments, and unlock access through NFT gates and a secondary marketplace.

ai.title: AI opportunity matching
ai.description: When someone posts a need or offer, Ring’s matcher scores relevance and notifies the right people — so collaboration starts from signal, not noise. AI routes attention; it does not invent balances or spend your tokens.

web3.title: Credit ledger + native token
web3.description: Members hold an in-app credit balance (fiat ledger points) and a custodial native-token wallet on Solana. Credits fund store, membership, and rewards; the native SPL token settles on-chain membership, desk trades, NFT buys, and P2P sends.

flows.title: Core money flows
flows.subtitle: Verified paths from WalletConductor, credit rewards, and Solana custodial wallets — not speculative marketing math.

rewards.title: Credit-balance rewards
rewards.description: Contribute on-platform — profile completion, verified identity, approved news, comments, reviews, requests — and Ring awards credit-balance units from config-driven rules. Awards are idempotent, role-multiplied, and UTC daily-capped. Credits are utility points you can spend; they are not speculative crypto.

sponsored.title: Sponsored native SPL (no SOL required)
sponsored.description: Your clone’s native token is an SPL token on Solana. Custodial wallets are provisioned on sign-in. When members send or settle, the treasury acts as fee payer — users operate the native token inside Ring without needing SOL for gas.

desk.title: Token Desk — credit ↔ native
desk.description: Subscriber+ converts credit points to native token (and back) through Token Desk quotes at the platform oracle rate. Desk trades are signed, executed server-side, and ledgered separately from store checkout accounting — changing the desk oracle never rewrites credit spend math.

send.title: Send tokens to contacts
send.description: From the wallet, pick a contact or enter an address, choose an amount, and confirm. Ring records the transfer and sponsors gas so the recipient receives native token without a SOL balance.

nftGate.title: NFT gating (KEYS)
nftGate.description: Solana Metaplex Core gate NFTs sell for native token. Membership gates can be soulbound; tradeable vendor KEYS unlock features only after staking in GateEscrow. Ownership alone is not access — stake activates GateResolver features.

nftMarket.title: NFT secondary marketplace
nftMarket.description: The Exhibition Marketplace lists verified KEYS gates and member-created collections, settled in native token. KEYS resale moves ownership; the buyer still stakes before features unlock. Member-lane mints transfer ownership only — no GateEscrow unlock.

matching.title: AI matching + notifications
matching.description: Matched opportunities trigger in-app and push notifications so relevant people show up without scrolling endless feeds. Matching stays advisory; payments and unlocks stay on the wallet and NFT rails.

microDao.title: MicroDAO — vote with native token
microDao.description: Project owners collect community priority through MicroDAO (public pools): members like and chip in native-token payments toward a goal. Admins and confidential users create DAOs; when signal or funding thresholds hit, the pool queues for delivery — votes that move treasury, not empty polls.

walletConductor.title: WalletConductor
walletConductor.description: One orchestration facade for card→credit top-up, Token Desk quote/execute, gasless native transfer, credit spend, wallet provision, and NFT market buys — the money counterpart to PaymentConductor.

creditLedger.title: Credit ledger + rewards engine
creditLedger.description: creditBalanceService owns fiat points. Reward hooks enqueue idempotent credit_add events with role multipliers and daily caps. SubscriptionConductor can renew membership from credit_balance on a monthly cron.

solana.title: Solana native + NFT rails
solana.description: Sponsored SPL transfers, RingMembership batch payments, NFT gate purchase/mint, and marketplace settlement run on Solana with custodial signing. External EVM wallets remain a separate connect path.

integration.title: AI ↔ money boundary
integration.description: AI matcher and generative tools consume attention and (where configured) credit spend. They never write vanity balances. On-chain native moves and NFT unlocks go through WalletConductor and gate/market services.

journey.title: A typical path
journey.subtitle: From first contribution to on-chain utility

step1.title: Earn credits
step1.description: Complete profile actions and contribute content. Rewards land as credit balance under published rules.

step2.title: Convert at Token Desk
step2.description: When you need on-chain native token, open Desk, get a quote, and convert points ↔ native at the oracle rate.

step3.title: Send, unlock, or trade
step3.description: Send to contacts, buy or stake KEYS gates for features, or list/buy on the Exhibition Marketplace — still without holding SOL for gas.

gettingStarted.title: Explore the live rails
gettingStarted.subtitle: Open wallet and NFT surfaces, or read the feature docs for operator detail.
gettingStarted.step1: Sign in — custodial wallets provision automatically
gettingStarted.step2: Earn or top up credit balance, then try Token Desk
gettingStarted.step3: Send native token to a contact, or browse NFT gates and market
